sources: 01-REVIEW-FIX.md rounds 1-3 fixes flagged for human verification (CR-01, WR-02..WR-06, IN-07, WR-17)
regression_scope: No prior phase exists; codegraph affected over 5beb4d9..HEAD only touches phase 01 code.

tests.name: xlsx column widths and wrap (re-test of UAT 17, G-01-H1)
tests.recipe: after T02: read column widths and wrapText of out/co-industrias-delta/formulario.xlsx (Datos Proveedor, Datos Bancarios) and out/hn-agroexport-sula/formulario.xlsx with exceljs; render QuickLook thumbnails (qlmanage -t) into screenshots/
asserts: co Datos Proveedor B=32, C=60, C13 wrapText true; Datos Bancarios B=22, C=27; hn Registro A=25, B=32
only cells whose text exceeds 60 chars (or contains a line break) wrap
bold labels, fills and faltante/por-confirmar notes preserved
human_checks: Open both xlsx in Excel or LibreOffice: no clipped label or value; the long 'Actividad económica' row reads in several lines

tests.name: Tone of borrador-correo, checklist and ENVIO-SIMULADO (re-test of UAT 20; WR-01, WR-02, IN-04 fixes)
tests.recipe: after T02: excerpt out/<caso>/paquete/borrador-correo.md for co, ec, hn, pa and checklist.md for a case with a foreign-issuer warning; confirmed simular_envio on ec and hn in a scratch copy and excerpt ENVIO-SIMULADO.md
asserts: no borrador contains 'firmado'
closing line is state-aware: co listo, pa con su confirmación, ec/hn todavía no está listo
missing master fields are asked to the client, not promised 'por separado'; only pending soportes are promised separately
no analyst-internal note text (reglas.json notas) is copied into a borrador
no bank field appears in any borrador
soportes appear by Spanish display name, never snake_case id; the foreign-issuer warning yields a client question and a checklist action
human_checks: Read the four drafts and the ENVIO record: professional tone toward the client, nothing promised that the master cannot supply
Confirm the new foreign-issuer question wording (IN-04)

tests.name: CR-01 resolution: stale or incomplete paquete/ rejects the simulated send
tests.recipe: scratch copy: (A) co full flow, delete paquete/rut-2026.txt, simular_envio confirmado true; (B) hn full flow, renew parafiscales in the soportes index (seed 01-soportes-index-renovado.json) between armar_paquete and simular_envio; (C) delete the formulario from paquete/; then re-run armar_paquete and confirm the send succeeds
asserts: A, B and C give ok:false, codigo PAQUETE_DESACTUALIZADO, the missing file names, and a message pointing to proveedor_armar_paquete
no ENVIO-SIMULADO.md written in A, B, C
after re-running armar_paquete the confirmed send succeeds and lists the renewed soporte
log.jsonl records the failed calls with codigo and no raw args
human_checks: Approve rejecting the send (PAQUETE_DESACTUALIZADO) over recording a bloqueo; note for phase 2: the agent prompt must answer this code by re-running armar_paquete

tests.name: WR-03 decision: demo stdout keeps raw soporte ids
tests.recipe: after T02: grep demo stdout for raw soporte ids (certificado_cumplimiento_tributario, parafiscales, rut) and show the lines
asserts: the only raw ids are in the Resumen/estado lines that mirror the tool resumen (contract v1)
human_checks: Decide: keep raw ids in demo stdout (document in SOLUCION.md) or request a plan to show display names

tests.name: Cold start: quality gates green from scratch
tests.recipe: rm -rf out && bun run check && bun test
asserts: check exits 0 (tsc strict, Biome, bun audit clean)
bun test exits 0 with 0 fail
no skipped or todo tests

tests.name: Demo without LLM key: four cases end to end
tests.recipe: env -u DEEPSEEK_API_KEY bun run demo.ts
asserts: exit 0, prints the effective execution date line
Resumen table: co xlsx 17/0/0 LISTO, ec pdf 13/1/1 BLOQUEADO, hn xlsx 9/1/1 BLOQUEADO, pa portal 8/0/1 LISTO
simular_envio unconfirmed answers 'requiere confirmación explícita' and nothing is sent
out/<caso>/ holds formulario (xlsx|pdf|valores-portal.md), mapeo.json, paquete/ and log.jsonl for each case

tests.name: Determinism across runs and roots
tests.recipe: run the demo twice in the repo and once in a scratch copy; diff stdout, file lists and contents (xlsx by cell, jsonl without ts)
asserts: identical stdout across the three runs
identical file list and content modulo documented volatile fields
no absolute path of either root in any output

tests.name: simular_envio confirmation gate (ENV-01)
tests.recipe: scratch copy; call proveedor simular_envio with confirmado false, missing, the string "true", true without paquete, then armar paquete and confirmado true
asserts: false and missing give ok:false, codigo CONFIRMACION_REQUERIDA, error exactly 'requiere confirmación explícita', no file written
string "true" gives ARGS_INVALIDOS
true without paquete gives PAQUETE_NO_ARMADO

true with paquete writes only ENVIO-SIMULADO.md listing only client files present in paquete/ (never checklist.md or borrador-correo.md) and the current bloqueos by display name, without requiring listo_para_firma

true with paquete/ missing a client file (deleted soporte, deleted formulario, or soporte renewed between armar_paquete and simular_envio) gives ok:false, codigo PAQUETE_DESACTUALIZADO, lists the missing files, asks to re-run proveedor_armar_paquete, and writes no ENVIO-SIMULADO.md (CR-01 fix)

tests.name: Reprocessing after a send cleans stale outputs (D-12)
tests.recipe: scratch copy; full flow on ec through confirmed simular_envio, then generar_formulario again
asserts: paquete/ and ENVIO-SIMULADO.md no longer exist
a fresh formulario exists

tests.name: Audit logs on every call (SEG-04, RN5)
tests.recipe: scratch copy; call each tool once incl. invalid args with a marker value; jq over out/log.jsonl and out/<caso>/log.jsonl
asserts: one line per call in out/log.jsonl
one line per call with a resolved caso in out/<caso>/log.jsonl
fields only ts, herramienta, ok, resumen (+ sesion, caso, codigo)
the marker value never appears

tests.name: Blank maestro value becomes faltante (CR-01 regression)
tests.recipe: scratch copy; set maestro ciudad to "   " and ciiu_principal to ""; run co through armar_paquete
asserts: mapear_campos counts both as faltante
xlsx cells carry the faltante mark
checklist lists both under Campos faltantes
borrador mentions them as pending

tests.name: Non-text maestro values need confirmation (WR-02)
tests.recipe: scratch copy; zz-generica-co (Gran contribuyente is a boolean) through mapear_campos and generar_formulario
asserts: the boolean field is requiere_confirmacion with a note and no value
no 'Sí/No' or joined text is written to the form

tests.name: RN1 enforced in code, not by data (WR-03)
tests.recipe: scratch copy; raise regla_pais and etiqueta_generica confidence above the threshold in reglas.json; map ec and zz-generica-co
asserts: ec RUC stays requiere_confirmacion
the generic tax-id label stays requiere_confirmacion

tests.name: Generic label consistency between tools (WR-04)
tests.recipe: scratch copy; synthetic case with a generic tax-id label absent from the glossary; call leer_solicitud and mapear_campos
asserts: leer_solicitud lists it in ambiguos with the country proposal
mapear_campos marks it requiere_confirmacion with the same proposal, not faltante

tests.name: Newest support entry wins (WR-05)
tests.recipe: scratch copy; soportes index.json with an older expired entry listed before a renewed one of the same tipo; armar_paquete on that case
asserts: the renewed entry is evaluated (presente)
the package is not blocked by the old copy

tests.name: Expired support is consistent across package, send and email (WR-06)
tests.recipe: after T02 (or scratch): read hn paquete/ listing, checklist.md, borrador-correo.md; confirmed simular_envio in a scratch copy and read ENVIO-SIMULADO.md
asserts: parafiscales is in paquete/ and marked vencido in the checklist
ENVIO-SIMULADO lists it under 'Soportes vencidos que no se envían'
the borrador names it 'Certificación de aportes parafiscales' as a pending soporte to be sent separately, never as attached, and never says 'firmado'
human_checks: Confirm the product decision: expired supports stay in paquete/ but are excluded from the send

tests.name: Both templates present: the format decides (IN-07)
tests.recipe: scratch copy; a case with both plantilla-celdas.json and plantilla-campos.json for formato xlsx, pdf and portal
asserts: xlsx uses plantilla-celdas.json
pdf and portal use plantilla-campos.json
no PLANTILLA_INVALIDA

tests.name: Checklist shows the issuing country (WR-17)
tests.recipe: after T02: read the soportes table of out/*/paquete/checklist.md and the armar_paquete response
asserts: 'País emisor' column holds a country code for every support
warnings live in the 'Aviso de emisor' column
armar_paquete returns pais_emisor per support
human_checks: Readability of the new column layout (see H3)

tests.name: No PII outside the forms (broad scan)
tests.recipe: collect every tool response, demo stdout, logs, mapeo.json, checklists, borradores and ENVIO-SIMULADO; grep for sensitive maestro values (NIT/RUC/RTN, account, SWIFT, cédula, names, emails, phones, address, revenue)
asserts: zero hits outside formulario and valores-portal.md
positive control: values found in formulario.xlsx and valores-portal.md

tests.name: Model-facing tool contract (CA2, WR-18)
tests.recipe: bun -e: list proveedor exports, descriptions and z.toJSONSchema of each args shape
asserts: exactly the five PRD exports
one-sentence descriptions
every tool reference in model-facing text uses the proveedor_ prefix
schemas have additionalProperties false and the locked field names

tests.name: PDF layout quality (ec)
tests.recipe: render a QuickLook thumbnail of out/ec-corp-andina/formulario.pdf into screenshots/
human_checks: Two columns, marks [FALTANTE] in red and [POR CONFIRMAR] in amber, Notas section, wrapping
tests.run_scope: prior-run pass (run 1); not in run 2 regression scope

tests.name: Checklist readability for the analyst
tests.recipe: excerpt out/hn-agroexport-sula/paquete/checklist.md and out/ec-corp-andina/paquete/checklist.md
human_checks: Wording of actions, table layout incl. País emisor / Aviso de emisor
tests.run_scope: prior-run pass (run 1); not in run 2 regression scope

tests.recipe: cite 01-01-SUMMARY resume signal and current pins
asserts: resume signal recorded verbatim
bun --version 1.4.3
human_checks: Already decided by the human during execution
